winter.name: WINTER CASE
winter.how: Winter bosses drop Winter Cases. Extract from Operation Whiteout for a bonus case. Or 14 shards.

supply.name: SUPPLY CASE
supply.how: Co-op and Endless only: one every 3 raids you hold, plus wins.

afterglow.name: AFTERGLOW CASE
afterglow.how: One for everyone in the run when the Demolisher, the Stormcaller or the Foreman goes down. Base Battle and Free-for-all: 45-50% after a win, 20% after a loss. Or 10 shards.

halloween.name: HALLOWEEN CASE
halloween.how: Dropped by the Butcher and the Ferryman. Or 12 shards.

flags.name: FLAG CASE
flags.how: A 25% chance for everyone after any win, co-op or PvP. Or 10 shards.

blitz.name: BLITZKRIEG CASE
blitz.how: Blitzkrieg Rush only: two for everyone each time a Blitzkrieg boss goes down, and one more for making the evacuation. Or 14 shards.

hybrid.name: HYBRID THEORY CASE
hybrid.how: One for everyone after any co-op win. Or 12 shards.
